articles.title: Expert analysis: Three key takeaways from latest China-EU trade talks
articles.titleCn: 专家分析：中欧最新贸易谈判的三大关键要点
articles.summary: CGTN takes a deeper look at the latest joint statement that addresses China-EU economic and trade ties.
articles.summaryCn: 中欧联合声明就电动汽车出口、医疗器械进口、稀土出口和知识产权等议题达成16项协议，专家认为这体现了双方合作意愿、中国推动更平衡贸易关系的承诺，以及中国是解决欧洲问题的伙伴而非根源。

paragraphs.en:
China and the European Union (EU) released a joint statement on Friday {{0}} a list of 16 agreements, including a reduction in China's electric vehicle exports, increased imports of European medical devices and {{1}} concerning rare earth exports and intellectual property management – all key issues at the center of trade tensions between the two sides. After a {{2}} period of {{3}} China-EU trade tensions, the joint statement offered a much-needed easing of tensions, bringing both sides back to dialogue and {{4}} enhanced cooperation and mutual understanding. To unpack the joint statement and examine the significance of the {{5}}, CGTN spoke to Jiang Feng, a research professor at the Shanghai Academy of Global Governance and Area Studies (SAGGAS), dean of the Institute for European Studies and chairman of the SAGGAS Council, who shared three key {{6}} from the statement. Takeaway 1: Both sides demonstrate strong {{7}} to cooperate and engage in dialogue
Jiang said the joint statement marked an initial success and sent a clear signal: both sides had demonstrated a strong willingness to cooperate and wanted to avoid a trade war. Words such as "dialogue," "communication" and "cooperation" appear repeatedly in the joint statement, highlighting both sides' willingness to engage with each other in a mutually beneficial manner.
paragraphs.cn: 中国和欧盟周五发布联合声明，列出了16项协议，包括减少中国电动汽车出口、增加欧洲医疗器械进口，以及有关稀土出口和知识产权管理的承诺——这些都是双方贸易紧张关系的核心关键议题。在经历了长期酝酿的中欧贸易紧张局势之后，联合声明提供了急需的紧张局势缓和，使双方重回对话，并释放出加强合作与相互理解的信号。为解读这份联合声明并审视此次磋商的意义，CGTN采访了上海全球治理与区域国别研究院（SAGGAS）研究教授、欧洲研究所所长、SAGGAS理事会主席姜锋，他分享了声明中的三大关键要点。要点一：双方展现出强烈的合作与对话意愿。姜锋表示，联合声明标志着初步成功，并释放出明确信号：双方都展现出强烈的合作意愿，希望避免贸易战。“对话”“沟通”“合作”等词语在联合声明中反复出现，凸显双方以互利方式开展接触的意愿。

paragraphs.en: Jiang noted that while both sides have made compromises, the agreements between China and the EU were based on {{8}} and equality. "While addressing the EU's concerns, China has also raised its own demands, including fair treatment and a favorable business environment for Chinese enterprises operating in Europe, urging the EU to refrain from adopting {{9}} measures against Chinese companies in areas such as public {{10}}," he noted. Beyond a step that stabilizes China-EU relations, Jiang also pointed out that {{11}} consultations carry significance in the greater global context. "Now that the two sides can sit down and negotiate a resolution to the pressing – and indeed serious – economic and trade issues they face, this not only serves the interests of China and Europe but also sets a good example for countries around the world to resolve {{12}} disputes and differences through consultation," Jiang said. In other words, success in reaching {{13}} between China and the EU on trade differences through a dialogue mechanism is not just an achievement for both sides but also a win for global economic stability and a rules-based trade order.
paragraphs.cn: 姜锋指出，尽管双方都作出了妥协，但中欧之间的协议建立在互惠和平等的基础上。他指出：“在回应欧方关切的同时，中国也提出了自身诉求，包括为在欧洲经营的中国企业争取公平待遇和有利的营商环境，敦促欧盟避免在公共采购等领域对中国企业采取歧视性措施。”除了稳定中欧关系之外，姜锋还指出，建设性磋商在更广泛的全球背景下也具有重要意义。姜锋说：“既然双方能够坐下来谈判解决他们面临的紧迫——而且确实严重——的经济和贸易问题，这不仅符合中欧利益，也为世界各国通过磋商解决双边争端和分歧树立了良好榜样。”换言之，中欧通过对话机制就贸易分歧达成共识，不仅是双方的成就，也是全球经济稳定和基于规则的贸易秩序的胜利。

paragraphs.en:
Takeaway 2: China is committed to working toward a more balanced trade relationship with the EU
Jiang noted that as a result of the consultations, the EU had secured demands it urgently sought, while China had honored its commitments and addressed major EU concerns. China has agreed to reduce its exports of new energy vehicles, increase imports of EU medical devices, lower tariffs and address existing market access barriers, reflecting its commitment to more balanced trade relations. The first major demand comes from Europe's automobile industry, "a key sector for Europe and the area where the EU feels the greatest pressure from China," according to Jiang. He said that the consensus to control the total volume of Chinese automobile exports to Europe is highly {{14}} and responds to the biggest demand of the automobile industries in Germany and other European countries. The second area of concern involves tariffs and rare earth export licensing, where room for adjustment has opened up.
paragraphs.cn: 要点二：中国致力于推动与欧盟建立更平衡的贸易关系。姜锋指出，作为磋商的结果，欧盟获得了其迫切寻求的诉求，而中国也履行了承诺并回应了欧盟的主要关切。中国已同意减少新能源汽车出口、增加欧盟医疗器械进口、降低关税并解决现有的市场准入壁垒，体现出其推动更平衡贸易关系的承诺。姜锋表示，第一个主要诉求来自欧洲汽车产业，“这是欧洲的关键产业，也是欧盟感受到中国最大压力的领域”。他说，控制中国汽车对欧出口总量的共识具有高度实质性，回应了德国及其他欧洲国家汽车产业的最大诉求。第二个关切领域涉及关税和稀土出口许可，在这方面已经打开了调整空间。

paragraphs.en:
According to Jiang, the fast-track mechanism {{15}} export licenses for rare earths and permanent magnets supplied to the EU is extremely important for the EU, who had previously expressed an urgent need for progress in this area. What China demonstrated in the dialogue has been consistent with what it has long claimed: that China is willing to maintain stable bilateral economic and trade ties and make them more balanced with the EU. Takeaway 3: China is not the root cause of Europe's problems but a partner in solving them
Wang Wentao, the Chinese minister of commerce who represented China in the consultations, has said that "China is not the source of Europe's problems but a partner in solving them." The message is clear here: trade cooperation between China and the EU will benefit rather than harm both sides. In recent years, however, {{16}} of China as an economic threat have continued to grow in some European countries, referencing a huge trade deficit of €360 billion. Jiang warned against such characterizations, calling for closer {{17}} of the figures used to support these narratives and cautioning against the {{18}} of portraying China as a threat.
paragraphs.cn: 据姜锋介绍，为供应欧盟的稀土和永磁体加快出口许可的快速通道机制对欧盟极其重要，欧盟此前曾表示迫切需要在这一领域取得进展。中国在对话中展现的立场与其长期主张一致：中国愿意维持稳定的双边经贸关系，并使其与欧盟更加平衡。要点三：中国不是欧洲问题的根源，而是解决问题的伙伴。代表中国参加磋商的中国商务部部长王文涛曾表示：“中国不是欧洲问题的根源，而是解决问题的伙伴。”这里的信息很明确：中欧贸易合作将惠及而非损害双方。然而近年来，一些欧洲国家将中国视为经济威胁的看法持续升温，并提到高达3600亿欧元的巨额贸易逆差。姜锋对此类定性提出警告，呼吁更仔细地审视用于支持这些叙事的数字，并告诫将中国描绘为威胁可能带来的后果。

paragraphs.en:
While the EU has repeatedly highlighted a trade deficit with China of more than €1 billion ($1.12 billion) per day, Jiang noted that this figure also counted in the substantial volume of goods produced by European companies in China and then sold back to Europe, which are in fact European companies selling to Europe. Additionally, Jiang noted that the {{19}} figure is the EU's goods trade deficit with China and does not account for its substantial {{20}} of trade in services with China, which leads to a {{21}} of the overall economic and trade relationship. Not only does the evidence underpinning the "China threat" narrative appear shaky, the result of spreading the political narrative of China as the cause of Europe's problems can also be damaging. "Presenting {{22}} as damage to European {{23}} and security is a classic case of extreme politicization and securitization of economic and trade issues," Jiang warned. "It will push up trade costs, tear apart industrial chains, {{24}} bilateral trust and ultimately harm the economic well-being of all parties."
Cooperation may, however, bring a very different future.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管欧盟多次强调对华贸易逆差每天超过10亿欧元（11.2亿美元），但姜锋指出，这一数字也计入了欧洲公司在中国生产并回销欧洲的大量商品，而这些实际上是欧洲公司在向欧洲销售。此外，姜锋指出，这个惊人的数字是欧盟对华货物贸易逆差，并未计入其在服务贸易中对中国的巨额顺差，这导致对整体经贸关系的误读。不仅支撑“中国威胁”叙事的证据显得站不住脚，传播中国是欧洲问题根源这一政治叙事的后果也可能具有破坏性。姜锋警告说：“将相互依存描述为对欧洲主权和安全的损害，是经贸问题极端政治化和安全化的典型案例。”“这会推高贸易成本、撕裂产业链、侵蚀双边信任，并最终损害各方的经济福祉。”然而，合作可能带来截然不同的未来。

paragraphs.en: Jiang suggests that China and the EU are both export-oriented economies that have the potential not only to strengthen each other but also to jointly contribute to a more stable global trade order. Jiang observed that in the joint statement, many of the agreements in the China-EU joint statement are framed within the broader context of the World Trade Organization (WTO). In other words, both sides are deliberately working together to build confidence in and {{25}} the authority of the WTO's fair-trade principles, which implies a potential for China-EU cooperation to strengthen governance of the global trading order. "I believe it is important to translate the valuable experience and approaches used to resolve problems between China and the EU into principles that can promote the governance of the global trading system," Jiang said.
paragraphs.cn: 姜锋认为，中国和欧盟都是出口导向型经济体，不仅有能力相互增强，也有能力共同促进更稳定的全球贸易秩序。姜锋观察到，在中欧联合声明中，许多协议都置于世界贸易组织（WTO）的更广泛框架内。换言之，双方都在有意共同努力，以建立对WTO公平贸易原则的信心并维护其权威，这意味着中欧合作有潜力加强全球贸易秩序的治理。姜锋说：“我认为，重要的是把用于解决中欧问题的宝贵经验和做法转化为能够促进全球贸易体系治理的原则。”

articles.fullText:
China and the European Union (EU) released a joint statement on Friday outlining a list of 16 agreements, including a reduction in China's electric vehicle exports, increased imports of European medical devices and commitments concerning rare earth exports and intellectual property management – all key issues at the center of trade tensions between the two sides.
After a prolonged period of simmering China-EU trade tensions, the joint statement offered a much-needed easing of tensions, bringing both sides back to dialogue and signaling enhanced cooperation and mutual understanding.
To unpack the joint statement and examine the significance of the consultations, CGTN spoke to Jiang Feng, a research professor at the Shanghai Academy of Global Governance and Area Studies (SAGGAS), dean of the Institute for European Studies and chairman of the SAGGAS Council, who shared three key takeaways from the statement.
Takeaway 1: Both sides demonstrate strong willingness to cooperate and engage in dialogue
Jiang said the joint statement marked an initial success and sent a clear signal: both sides had demonstrated a strong willingness to cooperate and wanted to avoid a trade war.
Words such as "dialogue," "communication" and "cooperation" appear repeatedly in the joint statement, highlighting both sides' willingness to engage with each other in a mutually beneficial manner.
Jiang noted that while both sides have made compromises, the agreements between China and the EU were based on reciprocity and equality.
"While addressing the EU's concerns, China has also raised its own demands, including fair treatment and a favorable business environment for Chinese enterprises operating in Europe, urging the EU to refrain from adopting discriminatory measures against Chinese companies in areas such as public procurement," he noted.
Beyond a step that stabilizes China-EU relations, Jiang also pointed out that constructive consultations carry significance in the greater global context.
"Now that the two sides can sit down and negotiate a resolution to the pressing – and indeed serious – economic and trade issues they face, this not only serves the interests of China and Europe but also sets a good example for countries around the world to resolve bilateral disputes and differences through consultation," Jiang said.
In other words, success in reaching consensus between China and the EU on trade differences through a dialogue mechanism is not just an achievement for both sides but also a win for global economic stability and a rules-based trade order.
Takeaway 2: China is committed to working toward a more balanced trade relationship with the EU
Jiang noted that as a result of the consultations, the EU had secured demands it urgently sought, while China had honored its commitments and addressed major EU concerns.
China has agreed to reduce its exports of new energy vehicles, increase imports of EU medical devices, lower tariffs and address existing market access barriers, reflecting its commitment to more balanced trade relations.
The first major demand comes from Europe's automobile industry, "a key sector for Europe and the area where the EU feels the greatest pressure from China," according to Jiang.
He said that the consensus to control the total volume of Chinese automobile exports to Europe is highly substantive and responds to the biggest demand of the automobile industries in Germany and other European countries.
The second area of concern involves tariffs and rare earth export licensing, where room for adjustment has opened up. According to Jiang, the fast-track mechanism facilitating export licenses for rare earths and permanent magnets supplied to the EU is extremely important for the EU, who had previously expressed an urgent need for progress in this area.
What China demonstrated in the dialogue has been consistent with what it has long claimed: that China is willing to maintain stable bilateral economic and trade ties and make them more balanced with the EU.
Takeaway 3: China is not the root cause of Europe's problems but a partner in solving them
Wang Wentao, the Chinese minister of commerce who represented China in the consultations, has said that "China is not the source of Europe's problems but a partner in solving them." The message is clear here: trade cooperation between China and the EU will benefit rather than harm both sides.
In recent years, however, perceptions of China as an economic threat have continued to grow in some European countries, referencing a huge trade deficit of €360 billion.
Jiang warned against such characterizations, calling for closer scrutiny of the figures used to support these narratives and cautioning against the ramifications of portraying China as a threat.
While the EU has repeatedly highlighted a trade deficit with China of more than €1 billion ($1.12 billion) per day, Jiang noted that this figure also counted in the substantial volume of goods produced by European companies in China and then sold back to Europe, which are in fact European companies selling to Europe.
Additionally, Jiang noted that the staggering figure is the EU's goods trade deficit with China and does not account for its substantial surplus of trade in services with China, which leads to a misrepresentation of the overall economic and trade relationship.
Not only does the evidence underpinning the "China threat" narrative appear shaky, the result of spreading the political narrative of China as the cause of Europe's problems can also be damaging.
"Presenting interdependence as damage to European sovereignty and security is a classic case of extreme politicization and securitization of economic and trade issues," Jiang warned. "It will push up trade costs, tear apart industrial chains, erode bilateral trust and ultimately harm the economic well-being of all parties."
Cooperation may, however, bring a very different future. Jiang suggests that China and the EU are both export-oriented economies that have the potential not only to strengthen each other but also to jointly contribute to a more stable global trade order.
Jiang observed that in the joint statement, many of the agreements in the China-EU joint statement are framed within the broader context of the World Trade Organization (WTO). In other words, both sides are deliberately working together to build confidence in and uphold the authority of the WTO's fair-trade principles, which implies a potential for China-EU cooperation to strengthen governance of the global trading order.
"I believe it is important to translate the valuable experience and approaches used to resolve problems between China and the EU into principles that can promote the governance of the global trading system," Jiang said.

articles.title: FBI official tells hackers to get in touch after major data breach
articles.titleCn: FBI官员在重大数据泄露后呼吁黑客主动联系
articles.summary: A senior US FBI official has made an unusually public ‌request to the hacking group ShinyHunters, telling the cybercriminals on Tuesday they should get in touch following a wide-ranging breach of the bureau's job site.
articles.summaryCn: 美国联邦调查局一名高级官员公开呼吁黑客组织ShinyHunters主动联系，此前该组织声称入侵了FBI招聘网站并窃取了大量敏感员工数据。

paragraphs.en:
A {{0}} US Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) official has made an {{1}} public request to the hacking group ShinyHunters, telling the cybercriminals on Tuesday to get in touch following a wide-ranging {{2}} of the bureau's job site. In a video message posted on X on Tuesday, FBI Assistant Director Brett Leatherman, who leads the bureau's Cyber Division, said the recent {{3}} of a Dutch man in connection with the ShinyHunters investigation should serve as a warning. A senior US Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) official has made an unusually public request to the hacking group ShinyHunters, telling the cybercriminals on Tuesday to get in touch following a wide-ranging breach of the bureau's job site.

An internal FBI memo circulated among employees said officials were operating under the assumption that every employee had been exposed.
ShinyHunters initially gave the bureau a week to retract an advisory about the hackers that the group took exception to, a period that expired on Tuesday. The hackers have since said the ultimatum was not a deadline or a threat and that they had no intention of publishing the data.
"This was all a marketing campaign," the group said on Monday.
'One of the worst breaches'
ShinyHunters said on September 22 that it had breached FBI systems and stolen information belonging to a huge number of current and former employees, claiming it had stolen data on "almost all" FBI agents and individuals who had applied for jobs with the agency. As evidence, it shared a screenshot of a vandalized FBI job site and what it described as a sample dataset containing information on about 5,000 agents.
The New York Times said the incident "is emerging as one of the worst breaches of sensitive government information."
BBC News also reported that current and former FBI agents had expressed shock, fear and anger following the hack.
Cybersecurity experts warned that such an attack could have long-lasting consequences. Cynthia Kaiser, a former FBI official and now senior vice president at cybersecurity firm Halcyon, said breaches like those claimed by ShinyHunters were "incredibly harmful" because they could be used by criminals to expose and put pressure on the people investigating them.
She noted that an old leak dating back to 2016 was still occasionally used to harass FBI agents. "Once that information is stolen, it is used forever."
ShinyHunters is regarded as one of the world's most notorious and attention-seeking hacking crews.
Its recent break-ins include the purported theft of millions of business records from video game developer Rockstar Games, the maker of "Grand Theft Auto," and a May intrusion centered on education tool Canvas that caused widespread disruption across US schools. Earlier this month, AI company Anthropic said it had caught ShinyHunters-linked hackers trying to use its tools.

articles.fullText:
The African Union's panel of facilitators has called for strict adherence to ceasefire commitments and continued diplomatic engagement to end fighting in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, following consultations in the M23-held city of Goma.
The panel said on Wednesday that lasting peace would require political dialogue and urged the parties to engage in good faith in the Doha peace process, while cooperating fully with ceasefire monitoring mechanisms.
A delegation led by Sahle-Work Zewde, former president of Ethiopia and deputy chairperson of the panel, held talks in Goma earlier this week with representatives of the United Nations peacekeeping mission in Congo, known as MONUSCO, UN and humanitarian agencies, as well as the M23 rebel group, the AU said.
Former Kenyan President Uhuru Kenyatta and former Botswanan President Mokgweetsi Masisi were also part of the delegation.
"Lasting peace requires political dialogue," the panel said, calling for restraint and warning against actions that could undermine the peace process.
Qatar has mediated talks between the Congolese government and M23 since March 2025. The negotiations have produced a declaration of principles and a framework agreement, with both sides committing to build trust through dialogue, advance stabilization in stages and address the underlying causes of the conflict.
The AU panel also called for greater protection of civilians and safe, unhindered humanitarian access. It said the findings from its consultations would be shared with the AU mediator and the Congolese government, while engagement would continue to build confidence and advance negotiations.
Corneille Nangaa, leader of the Congo River Alliance, a politico-military coalition allied with M23, told reporters in Goma on Wednesday that mediators should "go beyond general statements."
Nangaa called for "precise, clear and verifiable commitments" backed by mechanisms to monitor their implementation. He said the Doha process would only be sustainable if it addressed the root causes of the conflict and produced concrete measures to protect civilians.
Since January 2025, the M23 rebel group has intensified offensives in the eastern provinces of North Kivu and South Kivu, seizing several key cities, including Goma and Bukavu.

The Shenzhou-23 astronauts aboard China's space station sent video greetings to their motherland on Thursday, which marks China's National Day and the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China.
Commander Zhu Yangzhu and his crewmates Zhang Zhiyuan and Li Jiaying, or Lai Ka-ying in Cantonese, delivered their wishes for the country and its space program together as the space station, about 400 km above Earth, flew over China.
"When we look at Earth from the space station, that brilliantly lit land is the motherland we miss day and night," said Li, the first astronaut from the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to travel to space.
The three astronauts were launched aboard the Shenzhou-23 spaceship late on May 24 and have been in orbit for more than four months. They are in good condition, having completed in-orbit crew rotation with the Shenzhou-21 astronauts, repaired the station's solar panels in a spacewalk and deployed application payloads outside the station.
This year marks the 70th anniversary of the founding of China's space program. Remarkable milestones include the launch of the country's first satellite, Dongfanghong-1, the BeiDou Navigation Satellite System that offers global services, the Chang'e lunar missions, the Tianwen-1 Mars mission, the space station and the steady advance of crewed lunar exploration project.
"We can never forget that in deserts, mountains and on islands, a group of people have gazed at the stars and kept striving, generation after generation, for 70 years, creating the glory of China's space program," said Zhang, who is on his first spaceflight.
Zhu, from China's third batch of astronauts, is on his second spaceflight after the Shenzhou-16 mission in 2023 and is commanding a long-duration mission for the first time. "The 'baton of history' has been passed to us. We will certainly run this leg well, and keep safeguarding and building our home in space," he said.

周四，中国空间站上的神舟二十三号航天员向祖国发回视频祝福。当天是中国的国庆节，也是中华人民共和国成立77周年纪念日。指令长朱杨柱和队友张智远、李佳莹（粤语名黎嘉盈）在空间站飞越中国上空时，共同向祖国和中国航天事业送上祝福。当时空间站距地球约400公里。李佳莹说：“当我们从空间站眺望地球时，那片灯火辉煌的土地就是我们日夜思念的祖国。”她是首位前往太空的香港特别行政区航天员。三名航天员于5月24日晚搭乘神舟二十三号飞船发射升空，已在轨飞行四个多月。他们身体状况良好，已与神舟二十一号航天员完成在轨乘组轮换，在太空行走中修复了空间站太阳能电池板，并在站外部署了应用载荷。

今年是中国航天事业创建70周年。引人注目的里程碑包括：中国第一颗卫星“东方红一号”发射升空、提供全球服务的北斗导航卫星系统、嫦娥探月任务、天问一号火星任务、空间站，以及载人月球探测工程的稳步推进。首次执行太空飞行任务的张智远说：“我们永远不会忘记，在沙漠、高山和岛屿上，有一群人仰望星空，一代又一代人持续奋斗了70年，创造了中国航天事业的辉煌。”朱杨柱来自中国第三批航天员，此次是他继2023年神舟十六号任务后第二次执行太空飞行任务，也是他首次担任长期驻留任务的指令长。“历史的接力棒已经交到我们手中。

我们一定会跑好这一棒，继续守护和建设我们的太空家园。”他说。

articles.fullText:
An aerial view of the Hong Kong Park of the Hetao Shenzhen-Hong Kong Science and Technology Innovation Cooperation Zone, September 15, 2026. 
China's Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (HKSAR) is moving up the global innovation ranks. It has climbed one spot from last year to 14th among the 139 economies in the 2026 Global Innovation Index, released by the World Intellectual Property Organization on Tuesday, while retaining its fifth place in Asia.
Hong Kong maintained its eighth-place global ranking in innovation inputs and rose to 21st in innovation outputs. Among its key strengths, the city ranked second worldwide in market sophistication, while human capital and research climbed to sixth and institutions to seventh.
The rise in ranking came amid Hong Kong's full-throttle push for becoming a global sci-tech hub, as was pledged in its first five-year plan unveiled earlier this month. The HKSAR government has vowed to create a comprehensive industrial ecosystem covering R&D, commercialization, pilot and mass production in new technology parks in the Northern Metropolis.
It will also promote new industrialization tailored to local conditions, establish a distinctive industrial development framework, and advance the "AI+" initiative while strengthen computing infrastructure and accelerate the application of AI among small and medium-sized enterprises, said a spokesperson for the HKSAR government.
The Global Innovation Index is a ranking of the innovation capabilities and outcomes of economies worldwide. Its assessment covers a range of indicators, including institutions, human capital and research infrastructure, credit, investment, linages, the creation, absorption and diffusion of knowledge, and creative outputs.

2026年9月15日，河套深港科技创新合作区香港园区鸟瞰图。中国香港特别行政区在全球创新排名中不断攀升。在世界知识产权组织周二发布的2026年全球创新指数中，香港在139个经济体中较去年上升一位，位列第14位，同时保持亚洲第五的位置。香港在创新投入方面维持全球第八的排名，在创新产出方面升至第21位。在其主要优势中，香港的市场成熟度位居全球第二，人力资本与研究升至第六位，制度升至第七位。
